headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a dominant win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, finishing with a 10-5 final score. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a 4-hit performance, including a home run and 3 RBIs. The New York Mets also secured a win, taking down the Kansas City Royals 7-3 behind Sean Manaea's 7.0 innings pitched. In the American League, the New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory, while the Chicago Cubs fell short in Baltimore, losing 2-3.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Matt McLain, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds due to a left calf strain. Other players on the injured list include Tanner Banks of the Philadelphia Phillies, Brad Lord of the Washington Nationals, Owen Caissie of the Miami Marlins, John King of the Miami Marlins, Tim Herrin of the Cleveland Guardians, Ranger Suarez of the Boston Red Sox, and Connor Prielipp of the Minnesota Twins.

The New York Mets have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger, acquired from the Detroit Tigers in a trade for cash. Other trades include the Detroit Tigers trading Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash, the Philadelphia Phillies trading Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and the Houston Astros trading Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Pirates in 10-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a dominant win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, finishing with a 10-5 final score. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a 4-hit performance, including a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st homer of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a close game to the Baltimore Orioles, losing 2-3. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Place Matt McLain on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds second baseman Matt McLain has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain, effective retroactive to July 8, 2026. McLain's status will be re-evaluated in the coming days.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire Right-Hander Matt Seelinger**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger, acquired from the Detroit Tigers in a trade for cash.
